messages:
ana (pm): Quick flag from support: users are confused by the scorecard legend in prompt-sets. 'Regression' and 'Delta' icons look the same at small sizes. Need quick fixes before next release.

dave (design): Noted. Ideas: 1) switch the delta icon to a small chevron with +/- color cues; 2) add a two-word label under the icon in compact mode; 3) bump hit target size to 20px min.

priya (eng): Implementation considerations: icon swap + label is trivial. Increasing minimum hit size affects the grid layout; may need row reflow logic for very dense lists. Estimate 1 day for icon + label, 2 days if we do layout changes.

noor (a11y): A11y checklist: icons must have aria-hidden=true if we expose text labels; otherwise each icon needs aria-label. Color alone shouldn't convey meaning; add text or aria-describedby for the status. Also ensure tooltip text is readable by screen readers.

leo (research): In our last usability sessions, reviewers like scanning by color but also rely on the tooltip to decide action. Small label under the icon reduces error rates. We saw ~18% fewer mistaken approvals when labels were present.

ana (pm): Typo: it's ana not nana. But agreed. Decision leaning toward adding 2-word label and swapping delta icon. Priya can we ship the icon/label only for canary, keep layout change for later?

priya (eng): Yes, I'll feature-flag the label and icon change. Will include aria-labels per noor's guidance. Branch: feature/scorecard-legend-label. PR link when ready.

dave (design): I'll upload the small icons + compact-label spacing tokens. Also suggest copy: 'Regression' -> 'Regression (new)'? Might be verbose. I prefer 'Regression' and 'Delta' -> 'Change'.

noor (a11y): Prefer 'Regression' and 'Change' for clarity. Also request contrast check for label text at small sizes; use 14px semibold or 12px medium with 4.5:1 contrast.

ana (ana pm): haha fixed :) Thanks team. Action items: priya PR (label+icon+aria), dave upload assets, noor validate contrast. Aim for canary deploy this week.

priya (eng): Filing PR now, will ping here when draft is ready.

leo (research): I'll quick-run 5 power-reviewer sessions on canary once it's live to confirm the reduction in mistaken approvals.

ana (ana pm): Great. Closing thread unless blockers. Thanks everyone.
